title: ligularia holmii
intro: Ligularia holmii, commonly known as Golden Ray, is a flowering plant species in the daisy family. It is native to China and is valued for its medicinal properties and ornamental value. The health benefits of Ligularia holmii include its anti-inflammatory and antimicrobial properties, which may help alleviate symptoms of respiratory issues and skin conditions. The plant's bioactive constituents, such as sesquiterpene lactones, have therapeutic actions including antioxidant, anti-inflammatory, and anti-cancer properties.
